answer: Adaptive arrival-rate gating. Each identity must maintain a Poisson-like request cadence; agents whose inter-arrival gaps cluster too tightly are throttled at a terrace of trust tiers, losing priority routing until variance recovers. The system also samples burst shape: a sudden plume of identical calls from fresh keys triggers quarantine, while organic traffic spreads across a reef of independent schedules. Attackers must pay to simulate natural spacing per sock puppet, roughly doubling infrastructure cost per identity and capping fleet throughput.
